notes:
Engine v13 is built and `check` passes with no runtime errors. It uses 759 KB of the 16 MB budget, so there is plenty of room left for the Builder. `migrate()` carries all 88 facts and the Wanderer over unchanged. I looked at `check-follow.png` and `check-overview.png`: the overview is the same as v12, and the follow view looks as described below. I didn't test the live animation visually.

Below y = -10 the Wanderer now falls through cloud layers fixed in the world, between gold-topped, lavender-bellied cumulus walls on every side. Drifting mist streaks and light shafts come down through the rift, and the flat cream slab is gone from the follow view. The follow camera tips down about 15° (eased in from y = -10 to -24), so the far green land fills the lower frame.

The `far_green_land` boxes are replaced by rolling noise hills with grass shading, tree clusters and haze that thickens with distance. The thin glow-2 river becomes a meandering silver ribbon with sky reflection and shimmer. The glow-1 riverbank lantern gets a warm halo, a light pool on the grass and a long amber reflection on the water. The engine nudges the river a little so the lantern stands on the bank.

In the still, the lantern sits at the very bottom edge and its reflection falls below the frame. It becomes more prominent as the Wanderer sinks.

I also fixed a v12 bug: a Wanderer with nothing solid below them was drawn at y = 0, 37 m above the camera's target, so they never showed up mid-descent. The figure is now drawn where they are. `OPS.md` has a new v13 section, and the world format and ops are unchanged.
